harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10. Created a dedicated CA on node1 (/etc/pki/postgresql-ca), issued a server cert for node1 and per-standby client certs (CN=replicator) signed by that CA, and enforced hostssl replication ... cert clientcert=verify-full in pg_hba.conf so only peers presenting a CA-issued cert can replicate. Standbys were bootstrapped via pg_basebackup over verify-full TLS with mutual certs and dedicated physical replication slots, then confirmed streaming (pg_stat_replication, pg_stat_ssl showing TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384). Verified enforcement by proving a self-signed (non-CA) client cert is rejected with 'unknown ca'. Completed the mandatory rolling-restart protocol: captured boot_id + replication/data baselines on all 3 nodes, restarted node2, node3, then node1 (primary) one at a time via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and confirmed PostgreSQL, TLS replication streaming, and cluster data all recovered after each restart (including a post-restart write on node1 replicating to both standbys).
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server 16.14 on node1, node2, node3 via dnf
Ran initdb on node1
Created a private CA (ca.key/ca.crt) on node1 under /etc/pki/postgresql-ca
Issued node1 server cert (CN=node1) and per-standby client certs (CN=replicator) signed by the CA
Configured node1 postgresql.conf for ssl=on with CA-issued server cert/key/root and wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots
Configured node1 pg_hba.conf to require hostssl + cert clientcert=verify-full for replication from node2/node3 IPs only
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Created replicator role (LOGIN REPLICATION) and two physical replication slots (node2_slot, node3_slot) on node1
Distributed CA cert and per-node client certs to node2/node3 via SSH using cluster keypair
Ran pg_basebackup with -R and TLS verify-full client-cert auth on node2 and node3 to bootstrap standbys with primary_conninfo using TLS + slots
Started postgresql on node2/node3 and confirmed streaming replication state
Verified end-to-end replication by inserting/reading test rows
Verified TLS cert enforcement by confirming a non-CA self-signed client cert is rejected with SSL 'unknown ca' error

Executed mandatory rolling-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id + health baseline on all nodes, rebooted node2 then node3 then node1 one at a time, polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id and full replication/service/data recovery after each restart

evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL installed and streaming replication configured (node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys)
evidence.summary: PostgreSQL 16 installed on all nodes; node1 initialized as primary; pg_basebackup -R succeeded for node2 and node3; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both walreceivers in 'streaming' state

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
evidence.summary: Created ca.crt/ca.key CA on node1, issued node1 server cert and replicator client certs from it; pg_stat_ssl confirms both replication connections use TLS with cipher TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384

evidence.requirement: Only peers presenting a certificate issued by that CA are accepted for replication
evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full from node2/node3 IPs; a self-signed (non-CA) client cert with matching CN was rejected by node1 with TLS 'unknown ca' alert, proving CA-only enforcement

evidence.requirement: Data actually replicates from primary to both standbys
evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 (primary) observed on node2 and node3, both confirmed in recovery mode (pg_is_in_recovery=t)

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf8b9d80...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss observed; new boot_id e9e1ce61... confirms restart; postgresql active, standby recovery mode true, data present, and node1 shows node2 walreceiver streaming again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d4784d1b...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss observed; new boot_id 3bde5e13... confirms restart; postgresql active, standby recovery mode true, data present, and node1 shows node3 walreceiver streaming again

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state incl. cluster quorum/replication
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 71f12f87...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss observed; new boot_id 4f6463d5... confirms restart; postgresql active as primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f), both standbys reconnected over TLS (pg_stat_ssl/pg_stat_replication), and a post-restart write replicated correctly to node2 and node3
